hero.title: Executive Intelligence Platform™
hero.subtitle: The intelligence infrastructure for organizations that need to make decisions in complex environments.

challenge.label: The New Executive Challenge
challenge.title: The problem isn't information. It's interpretation.
challenge.desc1: Companies have ERP, CRM, BI, financial systems, operational tools, and artificial intelligence.
challenge.bullet4: What decisions can alter this trajectory.
challenge.conclusion: Illumine creates the intelligence layer between corporate data and executive decision.
challenge.intro: The challenge for modern organizations isn't collecting information. It is transforming fragmented information into executive understanding.

illumine.title: Illumine Executive Intelligence Platform™

layer2.title: Intelligence Engine Layer™

layer3.title: Executive Advisory Layer™
layer3.subtitle: The connection between intelligence and leadership.
layer3.desc: Capabilities: Executive Insights, Explainable recommendations, Board support, C-Level support.
